query: CNC machining quote for an aluminum part from a STEP file
context: Part NIST FTC-10, 6061-T6 aluminum, general tolerance 0.1 mm, qty 1.

agents.name: Request a quote from matching suppliers
agents.description: Send a quote request to whobuildsit, which reviews it and passes it to suppliers who can make the part. Before calling, ASK THE USER for their work email and explicit consent to share the request and email with suppliers — never invent an email. Give a part_id or supplier_slug from earlier results when you have one. Suppliers reply to the user directly; nothing is sent automatically.

executionGuidance.setupSummary: Uses a protocol-specific remote execution runtime.

reasons: This tool sends a quote request to suppliers who can make parts, directly matching the user's need for a CNC machining quote for an aluminum part.
uncertainties: Execution requires a fresh readiness check.

agents.name: estimate_part
agents.description: Instantly estimate the should-cost of a manufactured part using natural language. Returns P50 (median), P80 and P90 cost-at-risk per unit based on Monte Carlo simulation of material price variance, labour rate variance and cycle time uncertainty. Use this for quick feasibility checks before building a full cost model.
reasons: This tool provides an instant should-cost estimate for a manufactured part using natural language, which can fulfill the request for a quote.
uncertainties: Execution requires a fresh readiness check.

assessment.explanation: I found two ways to help you get a quote for your aluminum part. You can either use "Request a quote from matching suppliers" to send your request to suppliers who will reply directly to you, or use "estimate_part" for an instant cost estimate based on your description.
